changes: Add the Vishay CRCW standard thick-film family: 7,658 component entries from 0402 to 2512, covering 1% (E24/E96) and 5% (E24) grades and 0 Ω jumpers.
Add 1218 (3246) and 2010 (5025) package selections. The full default library now has 66,723 component entries, 348 footprints (including L/N/M density variants), and 28 families.

Correct Vishay RCS 0402 and 1206 land patterns to use the datasheet's bottom terminal length. The pad gap shrinks by 0.10 mm and the 3D models no longer swap the top and bottom terminal bands. Footprint names are unchanged, so refresh existing libraries with the footprint update script.
Use the Configuration File name for the Preview tab's Configuration JSON download.
Clarify that all other Altium document windows and tabs must be closed before updating managed footprints.
Fix Altium footprint update scripts to enumerate PCB documents through the documented server-module API and use the correct server-document properties.
Update matching managed footprints while skipping and reporting footprints missing from house.PcbLib; duplicate names still stop the sync before changes are made.
Expand the full default library to 59,065 component entries, 324 footprints (including L/N/M density variants), and 27 families.
Add 10 passive families: Murata GCD and KRM; KEMET X7R, Open Mode, and ESD C0G; TDK C; and Vishay RCS, RCP, MC Precision, and MC AT.
Extend Panasonic ERA-A with 0402 AEB/ARB parts, Samsung CL with selected automotive parts, and Yageo AC with 1210 parts.
Add manufacturer-recommended land patterns and dedicated terminal geometry for RCP and KRM, plus 2512 and KRM55 package selections.
Correct Panasonic ERA-V/K/P resistance codes, including ERA-2VEB9100X for 910 Ω and R notation below 100 Ω. This fixes 297 generated part numbers while preserving ERA-A numbering.
Correct 3D body height and offset units in generated Altium footprint libraries so component heights match the embedded STEP models.
Import previously exported configuration JSON from Configure → Presets → Import JSON, with validation before applying settings.
Add website revision history and a version link in the footer of every page.
Track the website version in builds and document promotion from dev to production through versioned releases.
Original website, including documentation, the browser configurator, and Altium library generation. This version number was assigned retrospectively.
